answer: The ocean test I would run is Audited balloon pilot licence with ballooning association attestation: a licence the association renews after flight audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the onyx compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The pigment grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
